name: Biscuit Barrier
flavortext: This tasty-looking shield protects from damage and boosts your regeneration.
notes:
While equipped, it speeds up your [[Regeneration]] indefinitely. 

The Biscuit Barrier restores 16 [[Mana]] every 6 seconds. Players who spend time within [[Resting Area]]s can make use of it for [[Magic Level]] training purposes.

This regeneration is also doubled if the appropriate [[Daily Reward System]] streak is maintained, stacking with [[Soft Boots]], [[Life Ring]], and  [[Ring of Healing]].
history:
* As announced on {{OfficialNewsArchive|7983|July 23, 2024}}, the cost of purchasing this item from [[Coco]] was reduced by half, from 16,000 [[Dark Chocolate Coin]]s to 8,000 [[Dark Chocolate Coin]]s.
* As announced on {{OfficialNewsArchive|8849|June 16, 2026}}, the [[Updates/15.25.3a4a52|Vocation Adjustments Update 2026]] raised its defense from 36 to 47.

name: Crypt Bile
flavortext: For long only rumored among necromancers to exist, this wand, known as Bonechant, hums with the faint chorus of the dead. One of the creations of the mysterious soul-smith.
notes:
This [[wand]] can be used on most hunting places in the game since very few creatures are immune to [[physical Damage|physical damage]]. Due to its 7 range, it is able to hit creatures located at any point of the screen, provided there is not a wall in the way.

This weapon's auto attack damage greatly changes depending on its weapon proficiency perks choice. Without any of them its attack damage is extremely low. It then ties with the [[Soultainter]] with the first perk, and when fully upgraded with the third perk it becomes the second strongest [[wand]]s in terms of auto attack damage only behind the fully unlocked [[Jungle Wand]].
